full_prompt_en: A square anime character illustration groups three school-age figures closely against a plain warm beige background. In front at the center stands a brown-haired girl, shown from the chest upward, with straight bangs, long hair behind her shoulders, large dark brown eyes, and a small composed smile. She wears a teal school blazer over a pale collared shirt, with an ochre vest and an oversized red bow at her throat. Behind her at left, an orange-haired girl turns slightly inward. Her shoulder-length hair is cut in a soft bob, and she smiles gently with wide brown eyes. She wears a red V-neck sweater with pale trim over a white shirt and a dark necktie. Behind at right, a blond boy leans in with a confident half-smile. His loosely layered hair falls over one eyebrow. His teal blazer has a small gold emblem on the chest, and a red tie rests loosely over an open pale shirt. Their shoulders overlap, creating a compact triangular arrangement: the front girl's head sits lower, and the two taller heads balance either side. The plain background contains no classroom or other contextual objects, so expression, hair color, and uniform layers define each figure. Outlines are clean but not uniformly heavy; color areas have gentle tonal changes and occasional fine texture. Warm skin tones, bright red accents, teal fabric, and golden hair make the palette cheerful without harsh saturation. Soft diffuse light removes hard shadows. The image is polished yet light, with simplified facial forms, carefully placed eye highlights, and subtly textured folds in the clothing. There is no readable text. The figures look directly outward, giving the image the feel of a friendly cast introduction.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形动漫角色插画把三名学龄人物紧密安排在纯暖米色背景前。前方中央是一位棕发女孩，画到胸部以上，刘海齐整，长发垂在肩后，深棕大眼与小小的安静微笑。她穿青蓝色校服外套、浅色翻领衬衫、赭黄色背心，喉部系着宽大的红蝴蝶结。左后方，一位橘发女孩微向内转。齐肩发梳成柔软短波波头，她用宽圆棕眼温和微笑；身穿有浅色边线的红色 V 领毛衣，内搭白衬衫与深色领带。右后方，一位金发男孩略向前靠，带自信的半笑。层叠发丝落过一侧眉毛；青蓝外套胸前有小金色徽记，松松的红领带压在领口打开的浅衬衫上。三人的肩膀重叠成紧凑三角：前方女孩的头较低，两侧较高的头互相平衡。纯背景不含教室或其他场景，因此神情、发色与制服层次界定每个人。轮廓干净，却并非处处等粗；色块有轻柔明暗变化和偶尔的细纹。暖肤色、鲜红重音、青蓝衣料与金发让色盘开朗，却没有刺眼饱和度。漫射柔光消除硬影。作品精致而轻盈，面部形式简化，眼中高光安排仔细，衣褶有细微肌理。没有可读文字。人物直望外侧，使画面像亲切的角色群介绍。
style_prompt_en: The polished school-anime treatment favors clean varied outlines, large luminous eyes, simplified facial planes, and soft color modeling. Warm beige negative space leaves a compact three-part arrangement easy to read. Teal, red, ochre, orange, blond, and warm skin tones are separated into clear blocks with gentle internal gradients rather than harsh shadows. Overlapping shoulders build an approachable triangular rhythm, and small differences in hair shape, expression, and layered fabric provide individual character. Fine texture and restrained fold lines add finish without complicating the silhouettes. Diffuse light and small bright eye accents make the mood open and cheerful. The image remains illustrative and slightly painterly around the color transitions, while maintaining crisp edges where forms meet.
style_prompt_zh: 精致学园动漫式处理偏向粗细有变的清洁轮廓、明亮大眼、简化面部平面和柔和色彩造型。暖米色留白让紧凑的三部分安排容易读懂。青蓝、红、赭黄、橘、金与暖肤色分成清楚色块，内部用轻柔渐变而非硬影。重叠的肩部建立亲切的三角节奏，发形、神情和层叠织物中的小差别带来个性。细纹理与克制衣褶线增加完成度，却不搅乱剪影。漫射光和眼部微亮重音使氛围开放愉快。画面保持插画性，色彩交界处略具绘画感，形体相接处则维持清利边缘。
theme_en: Three friendly school-age anime characters in coordinated uniforms against a warm plain backdrop
theme_zh: 三位亲切的学园动漫角色穿统一制服，站在暖色素背景前
name: Gakuen anime style
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
